name: contract-first
summary: For changes that cut across a codebase. An architect fixes the shared shapes and who owns what, builders work at the same time on their parts, a compatibility tester guards what must not change, a reviewer checks the whole against the spec.

roles.name: architect
roles.job: Reads the spec and the code, decides the shared shapes (data, functions, modules) and gives each builder its files.

roles.name: builder
roles.job: Builds one part with its tests, only in the files it owns. Use one builder per part.

roles.name: compat-tester
roles.job: Records how the existing behaviour looks before changes, and checks it again after every merge.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.job: Checks every rule of the spec end to end and sends problems to the builder who owns them.

steps.do: Write the shared shapes, the parts and their owners.
Record the current behaviour that must not change, before any change lands.
Each builder builds its part with tests, at the same time as the others.
Compare the recorded behaviour with the new code. Report every difference.
Check the spec rule by rule.

rules: Builders change only the files they own; shared shapes change only through the architect.
The baseline is recorded before the first change.
